original_card.question: Can a specified pair of consecutive calls eliminate a restoration that the next call reconstructs?
methods: Write typed entry/exit contracts and a contracting multitype recurrence.
Derive a lower bound for the compulsory transitions of one proposed typed interface.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show actual eliminated work and legal composition; changing a scalar recurrence into a matrix is insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Find a concrete consecutive-call boundary in the selected review and list its entry/exit obligations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Specify two call types and one operation actually removed by composition; derive the normalized recurrence.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Eliminating compulsory boundary work can lower recursive cost beyond packing gains.
allowed_variations: A two-type pilot or one explicit deferred restoration.
scope_change_triggers: Rewriting the old scalar recurrence as a matrix without eliminating work.

scope_change_reason: The direct selected-owner and signed-reader restoration boundaries are already crowded. Seed 56 refines the investigation to an order-four paired-cycle frame, distinct from PR1287's order-three frame, with a different phase group and an ADD/NEG cost vector. The five-child pilot tests actual repeated inverse-frame elimination and its complete dirty echo.
actual_scope: For five fixed equivariant children on three workspace octets and one output octet, find and verify the exact cheapest boundary schedule in the explicit four-state macro alphabet generated by the paired order-four frame, and compare its full arbitrary-dirty echo bill with eager restoration.
bottleneck_link: The frame carried through four child boundaries replaces four repeated workspace inverse frames by output-frame rotations and one terminal workspace correction. If an actual supplier admits this typed interface, the avoided primitives can reduce its recursive node bill; no current supplier is shown to admit it.
stop_rule: Exhaust all 4^5 phase prefixes for the five-child path, compare that minimum with the 4-state dynamic program, and verify all 56 basis columns of the complete dirty echo. Stop if typed composition fails or the complete bill does not improve; make no claim outside this fixed macro alphabet and fixture.
evidence: The exact four-state recurrence has path [0,1,2,3,0,0], boundary cost 140 ADD/NEG primitives versus eager cost 300. The complete echo costs 920 ADD plus 88 NEG (1008 total), versus 1208 ADD plus 120 NEG (1328 total), with identical map on all 56 arbitrary dirty/source basis columns. The corresponding internal C_v costs 974 ADD plus 94 NEG versus 1262 ADD plus 126 NEG and its map/inverse also pass all 56 basis columns. Exhaustive enumeration of the 1024 complete phase paths returns the same minimum as the dynamic program. Four failure controls detect a sign mutation, wrong output phase, omitted terminal restoration, and forward-for-inverse substitution. The optimized prefix row-L1 peak rises 11 to 20.
author: Cinna Davis
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in algebra, code, verification and prose. No independent human review or proof-assistant formalization is claimed.

open_questions.question: Does any actual selected or candidate supplier expose an indivisible order-four paired-cycle child interface satisfying R P = Q R?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A compatible real supplier is needed before the finite echo saving can affect a paid recursive profile or kappa.
open_questions.first_step: Inspect one named supplier's child boundary matrices for an eight-coordinate paired-cycle intertwiner, then price its full frame and inverse word.
open_questions.blocked_by: No physical hosting, source-family admission, finite-precision contract or matching supplier has been identified.
